# Particle Scattering in a Shear-Profile Current Sheet

This notebook studies particle scattering in the magnetic field configuration

$$
B_z = B_n = \text{const}, \qquad
B_x = B_0 \frac{z/L}{\!\left(1 + \tfrac{a}{2}\!\left(\tfrac{z}{L}\right)^{\!2}\right)^{\!2}}
$$

The corresponding field-line trajectory is

$$
x(z) = \frac{B_0}{B_n}\,\frac{\tfrac{1}{2}(z/L)^2}{1 + \tfrac{a}{2}(z/L)^2}
$$

which is the profile shown in the figure: field lines bend toward the
current sheet centre ($z=0$) from both sides and approach an asymptote
$x_\infty = B_0/(a B_n)$ as $|z|\to\infty$.

## Field profile visualisation

```{julia}
# Plot B_x(z) and field lines for several values of a and ε = B_0/B_n
let
    fig = Figure(size = (900, 400))

    # ── Left panel: B_x(z/L) profile ─────────────────────────────────────
    ax1 = Axis(fig[1, 1];
        xlabel = L"z/L",
        ylabel = L"B_x / B_n",
        title  = "Transverse field profile")

    ξ = range(-4, 4; length = 500)
    for a in [1.0, 2.0, 4.0]
        lines!(ax1, ξ, @. ξ / (1 + a/2 * ξ^2)^2; label = "a = $a")
    end
    axislegend(ax1)

    # ── Right panel: field lines x(z/L) ──────────────────────────────────
    ax2 = Axis(fig[1, 2];
        xlabel = L"x \cdot B_n / (B_0 L)",
        ylabel = L"z/L",
        title  = "Field lines  [x(z) = ½(z/L)² / (1 + a/2·(z/L)²)]")

    for a in [1.0, 2.0, 4.0]
        x_norm = @. (1/2 * ξ^2) / (1 + a/2 * ξ^2)
        lines!(ax2, x_norm, ξ; label = "a = $a")
    end
    axislegend(ax2)

    easy_save("scattering_field_profile")
    fig
end
```

## Single-interaction test

Solve one particle trajectory in the new field to verify the setup.

```{julia}
# Reference normalisation
B_n  = 10u"nT"
B_0  = 5u"nT"     # ε = B_0/B_n = 0.5
L    = 3000u"km"
a    = 2.0

cfg = ScatteringConfig(; B_n, B_0, L, a, sign = 1)

# Normalisation
norm_cfg = normalization(cfg)
@info "V₀ = $(norm_cfg.V₀)"
@info "t_c = $(norm_cfg.t_c)"

# Dimensionless field
B_norm = normalize(cfg)
@info "Field at z/L = 1: B = $(B_norm(SA[0.0, 0.0, 1.0]))"
```

## Parameter scan: ε and a

Vary the transverse-to-normal field ratio `ε = B_0/B_n` and the
profile shape parameter `a`, then analyse the resulting pitch-angle
diffusion.

```{julia}
function run_scattering_sim(d; verbose = false)
    save_everystep = false
    diffeq         = (; dtmax = 1e-3)

    cfg = ScatteringConfig(;
        B_n  = d[:B_n],
        B_0  = d[:B_0],
        L    = d[:L],
        a    = d[:a],
    )

    # Use the same solve_params machinery, passing the new field callable
    sols, (wϕs, B, u0s) = solve_params(
        RDProblemParams(;       # reuse infrastructure; field override below
            diffeq,
            B     = cfg,        # the ScatteringConfig acts as the field
            v     = d[:v],
            init_kwargs = d[:init_kwargs],
        ); save_everystep, verbose)

    results = process_sols(sols, B, wϕs)
    results.v .= d[:v]
    results.ε .= NoUnits(d[:B_0] / d[:B_n])
    results.a .= d[:a]
    d[:results] = results
    d
end
```

```{julia}
# Scan over ε = B_0/B_n and profile shape a
B_n_ref = 10u"nT"
L_ref   = 3000u"km"

config = Dict(
    :B_n        => B_n_ref,
    :B_0        => [2.0, 5.0, 10.0, 20.0] .* u"nT",   # ε ∈ {0.2, 0.5, 1, 2}
    :L          => L_ref,
    :a          => [1.0, 2.0, 4.0],
    :v          => [8, 16, 32],
    :init_kwargs => (; w = -0.8:0.1:0.8, Nϕ = 128),
)

all_params  = dict_list(config)
scan_results = produce_or_load.(run_scattering_sim, all_params, datadir("scattering"))
```

## Diffusion coefficients

```{julia}
using Statistics, StatsBase

function weighted_diffusion(df, s_fs)
    @chain df begin
        @rtransform! @astable begin
            :s_fs      = s_fs
            :v_para_0  = :v * :μ0
            :v_para_1  = :v * :μ1
            :T         = :t1 + s_fs / abs(:v_para_1)
            :Δs_para   = :s_cs + s_fs * (sign(:v_para_1 / :v_para_0) -
                             abs(:v_para_0 / :v_para_1)) -
                         abs(:v_para_0) * :t1
            :κ_para    = (:Δs_para^2) / :T
            :κ_perp    = (:Δs_perp^2) / :T
        end
        @transform! :w = @. abs(:μ0) * sqrt(1 - :μ0^2)
        @groupby(:ε, :a, :v)
        @combine @astable begin
            w             = StatsBase.weights(:w)
            Δs_perp_std   = std(:Δs_perp, w; mean = 0)
            Δs_para_std   = std(:Δs_para, w)
            T_mean        = mean(:T, w)
            :κ_para       = Δs_para_std / T_mean
            :κ_perp       = Δs_perp_std / T_mean
            :κ_ratio      = :κ_perp / :κ_para
        end
    end
end
```

```{julia}
result = let
    dfs = map(scan_results) do res
        d = res[1]
        d[only(keys(d) ∩ [:results, "results"])]
    end
    vcat(dfs...)
end

s_fs_ref = 1e4   # reference free-streaming distance (normalised)
dc_df    = weighted_diffusion(result, s_fs_ref)
```

## Plots

### κ vs ε for different profile shapes

```{julia}
let
    fig  = Figure(size = (900, 600))
    axis = (; xscale = log10, yscale = log10)

    ax1 = Axis(fig[1, 1]; xlabel = L"ε = B_0/B_n", ylabel = L"κ_∥", axis...)
    ax2 = Axis(fig[2, 1]; xlabel = L"ε = B_0/B_n", ylabel = L"κ_⊥", axis...)
    ax3 = Axis(fig[3, 1]; xlabel = L"ε = B_0/B_n", ylabel = L"κ_⊥/κ_∥", axis...)

    for (ia, a_val) in enumerate([1.0, 2.0, 4.0])
        sub = @subset(dc_df, :a .== a_val, :v .== 8)
        sort!(sub, :ε)
        label = "a = $a_val"
        c     = Cycled(ia)
        scatterlines!(ax1, sub.ε, sub.κ_para;  label, color = c)
        scatterlines!(ax2, sub.ε, sub.κ_perp;  label, color = c)
        scatterlines!(ax3, sub.ε, sub.κ_ratio; label, color = c)
    end

    axislegend(ax1; position = :lt)
    hidexdecorations!.((ax1, ax2))
    easy_save("κ_ε_scan_scattering")
    fig
end
```

### κ vs particle speed for fixed field geometry

```{julia}
let
    fig  = Figure(size = (600, 500))

                      linestyle = :dash)
    end

    axislegend(ax; position = :lt, nbanks = 2)
    easy_save("κ_vscan_scattering")
    fig
end
```

## Long-term Monte Carlo transport

Use the scattering configuration in the full Monte Carlo simulation to
obtain ensemble-averaged diffusion coefficients.

```{julia}
using ParticlesTransport
using ParticlesTransport: simulate_particle

max_time = 2e4u"s"
l        = 2 * 60 * 400.0u"km"   # ~48 000 km  (4-min wait @ 400 km/s)
energies = (100u"keV", 300u"keV", 1u"MeV", 3u"MeV", 10u"MeV")

# Build a deterministic sampler for ε = 0.5, a = 2 (reference case)
ref_sampler = build_scattering_sampler(;
    B_n       = 10u"nT",
    B_0_range = (4.5u"nT", 5.5u"nT"),   # narrow range around ε ≈ 0.5
    L         = 3000u"km",
    a         = 2.0,
)

scattering_results = map(energies) do e
    produce(
        Experiment(; e, l, id = "Scattering_a2_ε05", n = 512),
        ref_sampler,
    )["trajs"]
end
```

```{julia}
include("../src/plot.jl")

update_theme!(; figure_padding = 2)
plot_state_trajectories(scattering_results[3], max_time)
easy_save("scattering_trajectories_1MeV")
```

```{julia}
include("../src/diffusion.jl")

sc_dcs = estimate_diffusion_coefficient.(scattering_results, max_time) |>
         collect |> FieldViewable

_κ(κ) = upreferred(κ / 1u"km^2/s")
_E(e) = upreferred(e / 1u"MeV")

fig = Figure()
let plot! = scatterlines!
    axis = (; xscale = log10, yscale = log10)
    x    = _E.(collect(energies))

    ax1 = Axis(fig[1, 1]; ylabel = L"κ_⊥  [\mathrm{km}^2/\mathrm{s}]", axis...)
    plot!(ax1, x, collect(_κ.(sc_dcs.κ_perp)); label = "Scattering config (ε=0.5, a=2)")
    axislegend(ax1; position = :lt)

    ax2 = Axis(fig[2, 1]; xlabel = L"E\ [\mathrm{MeV}]",
               ylabel = L"κ_∥  [\mathrm{km}^2/\mathrm{s}]", axis...)
    plot!(ax2, x, collect(_κ.(sc_dcs.κ_para)))
    hidexdecorations!(ax1)
end

easy_save("scattering_diffusion")
fig
```
